newsitem.title: USA: Ascend sees $42.2 mln Cascade merger charge.
newsitem.headline: Ascend sees $42.2 mln Cascade merger charge.

text.p: Ascend Communications Inc said in a regulatory filing that it planned to take a charge of about $42.2 million to cover expenses related to its proposed merger with Cascade Communications Corp.
The proposed charge was revealed in a U.S. Securities Exchange Commission S-4 filing dated April 22.
Ascend said it expected to take the charge in the quarter in which the merger is completed, which Wall Street analysts expect will occur during the summer.
The $42.2 million charge covers investment advisory fees, legal and accounting expenses and other transaction costs.
Under terms of the merger deal announced in March, Cascade shareholders are to receive 0.7 of a share of Ascend stock for each Cascade share they own.
The deal, which valued Cascade at $3.7 billion based on Ascend's share price of $52 prior to the announcement, has since fallen in value. Ascend shares closed at 45-3/4, up 4-5/16 Wednesday.
